steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's make sweet and fluffy pancakes!
Wash your hands and tie your apron. A grown-up should always operate the warm stove.
We need creamy pancake batter, a touch of butter, and sweet fresh berries.
Scoop up the batter and pour a round pancake into the middle of the pan.
Let tiny bubbles form on top as the pancake rises and cooks to golden perfection.
Slide our spatula carefully underneath and flip the pancake over to cook the other side!
Cook one more golden pancake and stack them together high and fluffy.
Lift our fluffy pancakes onto the plate and top with fresh berries. Delicious!
